title: centaurea sonchifolia subsp. maritima
intro: Centaurea sonchifolia subsp. maritima, commonly known as blue thistle or mountain blue thistle, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea sonchifolia subsp. maritima are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Research has shown that these bioactive constituents contribute to the plant's ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial activity.
